summary: SAML assertions signed with RSA-PSS rejected by private auth proxy causing 403s for SSO logins
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports that users in their private deployment cannot complete SSO login. Requests to our auth proxy return 403 Authorization Denied.
Impact: All Aurelia Finance users in the eu-west private deployment are unable to sign in via SSO (affects web console and API token exchange for automation).
Environment: Private deployment (customer-managed control plane) running auth-proxy v1.8.1, auth-service v3.2.0. IdP: corporate SAML IdP configured to sign assertions with RSA-PSS (RSASSA-PSS with SHA256).
Observed behaviour: SAML assertion accepted by IdP and delivered to our endpoint, but auth-proxy logs show signature validation failure and downstream RBAC mapping is not performed, resulting in 403.
Expected behaviour: Our SAML verifier should validate IdP-signed assertions and proceed to role mapping; if algorithm unsupported, we should surface clear diagnostic and provide a compatibility path.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Configure a SAML IdP to sign assertions using RSA-PSS (RSASSA-PSS/SHA256).
2) Direct assertion consumer URL to private auth-proxy endpoint for the customer's control plane in eu-west.
3) Attempt SSO login from the Aurelia Finance console.
4) Observe 403 response and check auth-proxy logs for signature verification errors.
logs: 2026-03-01T09:14:22Z auth-proxy ERROR validate_saml_signature: signature verification failed: unsupported signature algorithm: rsa-pss
2026-03-01T09:14:22Z auth-proxy INFO inbound_assertion: saml_assertion_id=4b9f-... user=alice@aurelia.test status=REJECTED
IdP debug: Assertion issued at 2026-03-01T09:14:20Z; Verified by IdP logs as signed with RSASSA-PSS-SHA256
investigation: Initial triage: Support reproduced locally by generating assertions signed with RSA-PSS; our current saml verifier (xmlsec/java-saml wrapper) rejects rsa-pss algorithm tokens leading to signature verification failure.
Hypothesis: Underlying XML signature library does not advertise RSA-PSS support; auth-proxy treats the assertion as unauthenticated and returns 403 before RBAC mapping.
Corroborating evidence: Stack trace from auth-proxy points to xmlsec error path 'unsupported signature algorithm' and a unit test added locally fails on PSS-signed assertion.
Customer workaround tested: Aurelia Finance reconfigured IdP to sign with RSA-SHA256 (RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5) and SSO resumed immediately—confirms algorithm incompatibility.
Related internal notes: This surfaced because a subset of enterprise IdPs have moved to RSA-PSS by default. Not previously present in other support tickets.
resolution: Workaround: Customer temporarily switched IdP signing algorithm to RSA-SHA256 (PKCS#1 v1.5) which restored SSO within minutes.

Short-term fix: Backported a permissive verification shim into auth-proxy to recognize RSA-PSS algorithm OIDs and route to updated xmlsec bindings. Deployed patch to customer's private control plane as auth-proxy v1.8.2-pss-fix (hotfix).

Long-term plan: Upgrade saml/xmlsec dependency across private control plane images to a release that fully supports RSASSA-PSS and add automated tests for rsa-pss assertions. Corresponding GH PR created (see related_github_prs).
Customer communication: Advised Aurelia Finance of the fix and recommended an IdP transition plan once the dependency upgrade is in stable release (target: v1.9.0).
